premises.title: Dinosaur Getaways From Level 1 to 8 — Which One Outruns? 🦖
premises.hook_vo: Eight dinosaurs. Only one can really outrun danger.
premises.art_direction: A Late Cretaceous plain of Mongolia at dusk turning to night, sand dunes, scrub and a dry lake under a rising moon.

options.label: Armoured tank
options.vo: Level one: a low armoured tank of a dinosaur.
options.image_prompt: A heavily armoured ankylosaur standing low among moonlit scrub on a Cretaceous plain, bony plates catching silver light, a warm sunset glow on the dunes behind

options.label: Duckbill herd
options.vo: Level two: a big herd of duckbills.
options.image_prompt: A herd of hadrosaurs with tall crests drinking at a moonlit dry lake, ripples on the shallow water, a warm amber glow of dusk fading on the horizon

options.label: Horned grazer
options.vo: Level three: a horned grazer with a frill.
options.image_prompt: A small frilled horned dinosaur grazing on low ferns beside sand dunes at night, its beaked face lit by the moon and a warm golden glow of the last sunset

options.label: Long-necked giant
options.vo: Level four: a slow long-necked giant.
options.image_prompt: A towering long-necked titanosaur walking slowly across a moonlit plain, its huge body outlined by a warm orange dusk glow, dust drifting around its legs

options.label: Ostrich dinosaur
options.vo: Level five: a long-legged ostrich dinosaur.
options.image_prompt: A long-legged feathered ornithomimid sprinting across moonlit sand dunes, tail held straight, dust kicked up behind it, warm sunset light glowing on the horizon

options.label: Sickle-claw raptor
options.vo: Level six: a raptor with a sickle claw.
options.image_prompt: A feathered velociraptor crouched on a moonlit sandstone ledge, curved sickle claw raised, golden eyes shining, a warm ember glow of dusk behind the dunes

options.label: Giant claws
options.vo: Level seven: a giant with metre-long claws.
options.image_prompt: A huge therizinosaur with enormous long curved claws standing among tall moonlit conifers, shaggy feathers in silver light, a warm amber glow of the last dusk

options.label: Tarbosaurus
options.vo: Level eight: a tyrannosaur, fully grown.
options.image_prompt: A massive tarbosaurus tyrannosaur stepping out of night mist on a Cretaceous plain, jaws open, scaled hide lit by the moon and a warm red glow of the setting sun

premises.verdict_vo: Real answer: number 5, because Gallimimus was probably a fleet runner, with speed estimated at up to 56 km/h.

fact.text: As an ornithomimid, Gallimimus would have been a fleet animal, using its speed to escape predators; its speed has been estimated at 42–56 km/h.
fact.source_sentence: As an ornithomimid, Gallimimus would have been a fleet (or cursorial) animal, using its speed to escape predators; its speed has been estimated at 42–56 km/h (29–34 mph).

premises.description: Eight Late Cretaceous dinosaurs, from an armoured tank to a full-grown tyrannosaur. Only one was built to simply run away.
